1.name: Decline Push-up (Feet on Bench)
1.description: Put your feet on the bench, body angled downward. Harder than a regular push-up, with more work for the front shoulders. Hands shoulder-width, elbows slightly bent.

2.name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
2.description: Lie on the bench, dumbbells at chest height, press up explosively, lower slowly. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.

3.name: Incline Push-up (Hands on Bench)
3.description: Hands on the bench, body angled. An easier variation with less weight on your arms. Keep your core braced.

4.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
4.description: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height, press straight up. Don't arch your lower back.

5.name: Lateral Raise
5.description: Lean slightly forward, raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height. Controlled motion, no swinging.

6.name: Front Raise
6.description: Raise your arms forward up to shoulder height, alternating or together. Keep your back straight.

7.name: Triceps Dips (Bench)
7.description: Hands on the bench behind you, legs straight or bent. Lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the floor, then press up.

8.name: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
8.description: Hold the dumbbell behind your head (one or both hands), elbows fixed, extend and bend.

9.name: Close-Grip Push-up (Diamond)
9.description: Hands close together (diamond shape), elbows tucked to your body. Hits the triceps hard.

10.name: Wide-Grip Pull-up (Overhand)
10.description: Hands wider than shoulder-width, palms facing away. Pull your chest to the bar, lower slowly. Retract your shoulder blades.

11.name: Chin-up (Close Underhand)
11.description: Close underhand grip, palms facing you. Chin over the bar — also targets the biceps.

12.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-up (Parallel)
12.description: Palms facing each other (if handles are available). Chin over the handles, lower slowly. Works the back similarly to an overhand pull-up.

13.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
13.description: Brace your knee and hand on the bench, pull the dumbbell from the floor to your hip. Keep your elbow close to your body.

14.name: Dumbbell Pullover
14.description: Lie along or across the bench (across: only your shoulders on the bench), lower the dumbbell with both hands behind your head and pull it back. Stretches the rib cage and back.

15.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
15.description: Arms extended, curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders. Keep your elbows pinned to your body, no swinging.

16.name: Hammer Curl
16.description: Palms facing each other (neutral grip), perform curls. Works the biceps, brachialis and brachioradialis.

17.name: Concentration Curl
17.description: Seated, brace your elbow against the inside of your knee, curl slowly. Maximum biceps isolation.

18.name: Hanging Knee Raise
18.description: Hang from the bar, pull your knees to your chest. Lower slowly. Variation: straight legs for more intensity.

19.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (DB)
19.description: Rear foot on the bench, front foot well forward. Lower deep, knee pointing forward. Works the thighs and glutes, one leg at a time.

20.name: Romanian Deadlift (DB)
20.description: Slightly bent knees, dumbbells close to your body down your legs. Keep tension in the hamstrings.

21.name: Hip Thrust (Bench)
21.description: Shoulders on the bench, lower your hips and drive up explosively. Place a dumbbell on your hips for more resistance.

22.name: Reverse Lunge (DB)
22.description: Step back, lower your knee toward the floor, return to the start. Alternate sides.

23.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
23.description: One hand on the bar for balance, rise onto your toes on one leg. Slow and controlled.

24.name: Plank
24.description: Forearms or hands, body straight as a board. Brace your core, don't let your hips sag. Increase the hold time.

25.name: Burpees
25.description: From standing into a push-up position, push-up, back up, jump with your arms overhead. Explosive and without pause.

26.name: Jump Squats
26.description: Squat down, then jump up explosively. Land softly, straight into the next rep.

27.name: Mountain Climbers
27.description: Plank position, drive your knees to your chest quickly, alternating. As fast as possible, keep your hips low.

28.name: High Knees
28.description: Run in place, driving your knees up to your hips explosively. Move your arms along. Maximum pace.

29.name: Explosive Pull-ups
29.description: Pull up explosively, as high as possible. Brief pause at the top, lower under control. Alternative: kipping pull-ups.

30.name: Clap Push-ups
30.description: Standard push-up, push up explosively, clap your hands, land softly. Only if your basic push-up is solid.

31.name: Box Jumps (on Bench)
31.description: Jump onto the bench from standing, land softly, step down (don't jump back). Go higher gradually.

32.name: Sprinter Lunges
32.description: From a lunge, explosively drive your rear knee forward and up. Alternate left/right, maximum pace.

33.name: Jumping Jacks
33.description: Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead, then back. Keep it relaxed and steady, land softly on the balls of your feet.

34.name: Arm Circles
34.description: Stand tall, arms out to the sides, and circle them. Start small, then go bigger, and switch direction halfway through.

35.name: Hip Circles
35.description: Feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips. Move your pelvis slowly in big circles and switch direction halfway through.

36.name: Bodyweight Squat
36.description: Feet about shoulder-width apart, lower your hips back and down as if sitting onto a chair. Chest up, come back up smoothly and under control.

37.name: Lunge with Twist
37.description: Take a big step forward, lower your back knee toward the floor and turn your upper body toward your front leg. Return to standing, switch sides.

38.name: Chest Stretch at the Bar
38.description: Place your forearm at shoulder height against an upright of the pull-up bar or a door frame, elbow at roughly a right angle. Slowly turn your upper body away until you feel a stretch in your chest. Hold, then switch sides.

39.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
39.description: Bring one arm straight across your chest and gently pull it in with your other hand, just above the elbow. Hold, then switch sides.

40.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
40.description: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand points down between your shoulder blades. Gently press the elbow back with your other hand. Hold, then switch sides.

41.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
41.description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front. Squeeze your glutes and slowly push your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip on your kneeling side. Hold, then switch sides.

42.name: Standing Quad Stretch
42.description: Stand on one leg, grab your other foot behind you and pull the heel toward your glutes. Keep your knees close together, the bent one pointing down. Hold, then switch sides.

43.name: Hamstring Stretch (Heel on Bench)
43.description: Rest one heel on the bench, leg almost straight. Keeping your back straight, hinge forward from the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of your thigh. Hold, then switch sides.

44.name: Dead Hang
44.description: Hang from the pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip, feet off the floor. Relax your shoulders, let them slide upward and breathe calmly.

4.name: HIT — Tabata (20 sec on / 10 sec rest × 8)
